assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
The symptoms are episodic in nature.
There is a need to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances.
CPT code 93226 is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study.
CPT code 93226 is medically necessary to capture potential arrhythmic episodes and confirm the diagnosis.
The study is supported by the diagnosis codes I48.0 and I47.1.
The study will assist in guiding appropriate rate or rhythm control management.
The management is consistent with the clinical indication note.
